courses.title: Flutter & Dart Mobile Engineering
courses.description: Master cross-platform mobile app development with Flutter 3. Learn reactive UI, clean architecture, offline storage, and production-ready video playback.
courses.instructorTitle: Lead Mobile Architect at Abyssinia Tech

chapters.title: Module 1: Flutter Fundamentals & Clean UI
chapters.description: Widget trees, stateful vs stateless, responsive layout architecture, and Material 3 design.

lessons.title: 1.1 Introduction to Reactive Widgets & State
lessons.description: Deep dive into Flutter rendering pipeline, element trees, and reactive state updates.

lessons.title: 1.2 Designing Custom Components & Themes
lessons.description: Building reusable design tokens, typography, gradients, and polished glassmorphic surfaces.

chapters.title: Module 2: State Management & Offline Caching
chapters.description: Clean data layer, Provider architecture, local persistence, and background downloads.

lessons.title: 2.1 Provider Architecture & Repository Pattern
lessons.description: Separation of concerns between UI views, ViewModels, and data repositories.

lessons.title: 2.2 Local Video Storage & Offline Playback
lessons.description: Handling byte-stream downloads, caching files on local disk, and playing without network.

chapters.title: Module 3: Production Readiness & Optimization
chapters.description: Memory profiling, battery efficiency, release APK builds, and submission guidelines.

lessons.title: 3.1 Memory Profiling & Video Controller Cleanup
lessons.description: Preventing memory leaks, controller disposal, and smooth 60fps scrolling performance.

lessons.title: 3.2 Building Signed Release APKs
lessons.description: Gradle build optimization, ProGuard shrinking, and APK distribution best practices.

courses.title: Full-Stack Cloud & Microservices
courses.description: Build high-throughput REST and gRPC backend microservices with Docker, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL for enterprise cloud workloads.

chapters.title: Module 1: REST & gRPC API Engineering
chapters.description: Modern API design protocols, rate limiting, and structured logging.

lessons.title: 1.1 Microservice Architecture Fundamentals
lessons.description: Decomposing monoliths into decoupled, resilient microservices.

lessons.title: 1.2 High Performance gRPC Streaming
lessons.description: Protobuf serialization, HTTP/2 multiplexing, and bi-directional streaming.

chapters.title: Module 2: Containerization & Cloud Orchestration
chapters.description: Multi-stage Docker builds, Kubernetes pods, and CI/CD automation.

lessons.title: 2.1 Docker Packaging & Security Best Practices
lessons.description: Slim base images, non-root users, vulnerability scanning, and caching layers.

lessons.title: 2.2 Kubernetes Deployment & Load Balancing
lessons.description: Ingress controllers, auto-scaling, health checks, and rolling rollouts.

courses.title: Mobile UI/UX Design Systems
courses.description: Create intuitive, accessible, and breathtaking digital experiences. Learn color theory, typographic hierarchy, micro-interactions, and design tokens.

chapters.title: Module 1: Design Tokens & Layout Architecture
chapters.description: Color contrast, accessible typography, 8pt spatial grid, and visual balance.

lessons.title: 1.1 The Anatomy of High-Converting Mobile UIs
lessons.description: Visual weight, scan patterns (F & Z patterns), and call-to-action placement.

lessons.title: 1.2 Designing Scalable Design Systems
lessons.description: Creating reusable atomic design components: buttons, inputs, modals, and sheets.

chapters.title: Module 2: Micro-Interactions & Motion Design
chapters.description: Delightful animations, haptic cues, transitions, and gesture navigation.

lessons.title: 2.1 Micro-Animations that Delight Users
lessons.description: Spring curves, button morphs, skeleton loading states, and feedback loops.

lessons.title: 2.2 Accessibility & Contrast Standards (WCAG 2.2)
lessons.description: Screen reader support, minimum touch targets (48x48dp), and accessible colors.

courses.title: Data Structures & Algorithmic Thinking
courses.description: Conquer technical coding interviews and develop blazing-fast software. Deep dive into trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and complexity analysis.

chapters.title: Module 1: Trees, Graphs & Memory Layout
chapters.description: Binary search trees, heap structures, and graph traversal paradigms.

lessons.title: 1.1 Graph Traversals: BFS vs DFS in Practice
lessons.description: Adjacency lists, shortest path algorithms, cycle detection, and memory footprints.

lessons.title: 1.2 Self-Balancing Trees & Priority Queues
lessons.description: AVL rotations, Red-Black invariant logic, and priority queue implementations.

chapters.title: Module 2: Dynamic Programming & Greedy Strategies
chapters.description: Optimal substructure, memoization tables, bottom-up tabulation, and space compression.

lessons.title: 2.1 Memoization vs Tabulation Masterclass
lessons.description: Overcoming recursion stack limits with state transition tables.

lessons.title: 2.2 Knapsack & Interval Scheduling Optimization
lessons.description: Real-world trade-off analysis, greedy proofs, and complexity bounds.
